title: ホープフルSの後に・結果は上々！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket achieves excellent results, proving her ability to handle a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide drop by to congratulate her, leaving Winning Ticket deeply moved by the friendship that the three share.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Yayoi Sho, where Winning Ticket will face off against Narita Taishin.
